justification: Changes which council rules the nightly quote check may prove as the council's words. Measured on all 617 unproven shown rules: 34 become exact (18 Penrith, 16 Parramatta), each eye-checked against the stored rule; 0 others change.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a short labelled lead-in or an unpunctuated last labelled item is refused again, or an unlabelled short lead-in is accepted
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-28: on the old council_quote.py the new tests give 2 failed (short lead-in, unpunctuated last item).

pre_impl.existing_data: Penrith 2026-10-28: 27 shown rules unproven; most are a lead-in ('5. Rear setbacks:') plus one item, refused by prove_pieces guards (lead-in under MIN_CHARS, item without end punctuation).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The guards assumed short or unpunctuated lines are two-column fragments. A line starting with its own list label is a whole council item.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Relaxes two guards in the existing prove_pieces path for labelled lines only; no new status, table or column.

functions.name: prove_pieces
functions.input: the stored rule body split into lines, the chapter's text streams, the stored page
functions.output: the council's text of each line and the page, or None
functions.if_none: an empty body or a single line returns None, as before

values.if_missing: no lines gives None and the rule stays unconfirmed

break_it.scenario: A short unlabelled heading ('Rear setbacks:') matches by chance elsewhere.
break_it.what_happens: A rule could be proven from the wrong place.
break_it.how: Only a line starting with a list label and ending in ':' may be short.

break_it.scenario: An unpunctuated fragment in the middle of a row.
break_it.what_happens: A two-column fragment row could be proven.
break_it.how: Only the LAST line may lack end punctuation, and only if labelled.

break_it.scenario: The item is matched under a different list's lead-in.
break_it.what_happens: The quote would join the wrong list item to a lead-in.
break_it.how: Unchanged guards: lead-in on the stored page or the one before, item after it within one page; fleet run 34 of 34 eye-checked.

post_merge.db_reset: No. Takes effect at the next nightly council_quote --apply --unchecked run.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: after the nightly run, Penrith shown unconfirmed count falls from 27 to about 9.
